name: zodiacs-sky
description: Explore sky events and astronomical facts, or open Chart Studio to inspect an interactive chart calculated in the browser.

interface.longDescription:
Developed by Zodiacs LLC, the operator of Zodiacs.org. See what changes this week, explore new and full Moons, and check astronomical claims with explicit timezones and versioned calculation receipts. The sky calendar supports inline, sidebar and conversation panels. Public-sky tools need no account or birth information. Chart Studio starts with a synthetic example and calculates personal UTC inputs in the browser. Inspect placements and aspects, compare Placidus and whole-sign houses, step through UTC time and explore possible birth-time windows. Chart Inspector reads calculation records locally, compares them and checks reproduction with the installed engine. Downloaded records contain personal chart data. Only reviewed selections are shared with the assistant; derived chart facts can reveal personal information. Event windows are at most 31 days; supported searches cover sign ingresses, planetary stations and lunations, with tested but unproven completeness. No reminders, eclipse search, personal chart storage or predictions of outcomes are offered. This is a review candidate; dated staging host evidence is recorded, while production and directory listing await release checks.

Official website: https://zodiacs.org/ . Company and contact: https://zodiacs.org/about/ . Support: admin@zodiacs.org . Methods and developer documentation: https://zodiacs.org/developers/ . Privacy and terms are linked in this profile.

positive.prompt: What can Zodiacs calculate and which engine version does it use?
positive.expected_behavior: List the six operations, published engine version, limits and privacy.

positive.description: Compute an explicit instant in Bangkok.
positive.prompt: Show the sky at 06:00 UTC on October 1, 2026, displayed in Asia/Bangkok.
positive.expected_behavior: Return computed positions and Moon phase, UTC and display timezone, calculation receipt and optional method links.

positive.description: Find lunar events in a bounded week.
positive.prompt: Find new and full Moons from October 1 to October 8, 2026, at midnight UTC, displayed in America/New_York.
positive.expected_behavior: Return computed events or an honest empty window, local times and tested-not-proven coverage; render the sky calendar.

positive.description: Preserve an ambiguous date-only ingress claim.
positive.prompt: Did the Sun enter Libra on September 23, 2026? I haven't chosen a timezone.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve depends when the crossing fits some local-day interpretations and explain the date/timezone basis.

positive.description: Find a calculator with a canonical link.
positive.prompt: Where is the Zodiacs Moon sign calculator?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the canonical Moon sign calculator link and explain its purpose; include no personal URL data.

positive.description: Open an interactive chart without sending birth data as tool arguments.
positive.prompt: Open Chart Studio so I can compare house systems.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with {}, render the synthetic example, allow local calculation and house comparison, and share only after explicit preview and confirmation.

review.commerce_description: The public-sky plugin sells no products and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: 0.2.0 adds Chart Studio: a self-contained browser calculation panel, placement/aspect inspection, Placidus/whole-sign comparison, record download and explicit reviewed selection sharing. Six public tool entrypoints; the five sky operations retain their limits. Engine rc.16. Prior staging/calendar evidence does not establish Chart Studio host acceptance. Public production/listing, updated host acceptance and consenting beta acceptance remain release gates. The existing demo link is historical calendar evidence, not a Chart Studio recording.
